title: The screens you will use most
summary: Several jobs in TCG Card Shop Simulator happen on their own screen: rarity, prices, storage settings and expansion each have a dedicated place rather than one menu.
body: Choosing a card's rarity has its own screen, so handling a card and deciding how it is presented are separate moments.
Prices get their own screen as well, both for checking what something is worth and for tagging it on the floor.
Growth is split the same way: storage shelves have a settings screen, and expansion has its own, which is why a busy shop is a rotation between a few places rather than one long menu.
What this entry does not tell you: what anything costs or which screen earns you the most. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: Rarity is chosen on a screen of its own.
Prices are checked on a screen of their own.
Storage shelves have their own settings screen.
The till screens are built from named groups, including ones for giving change and for the item list.
The build ships a shop menu icon of its own.
Menus have open and close sounds of their own, and confirming and cancelling each have one as well.
facts.evidence: asset names: SFX_MenuOpen, SFX_MenuClose, SFX_Confirm, SFX_Cancel
